title: [FLINK-41078][runtime] Complete slot manager debounce futures on failure
body:
## What is the purpose of the change

One exception inside the delayed requirements check or the delayed resource declaration leaves its debounce future incomplete, so `FineGrainedSlotManager` never schedules that check again for the rest of the ResourceManager's life. Details in FLINK-41078.

## Brief change log

  - Complete `requirementsCheckFuture` and `declareNeededResourceFuture` in a `finally`.

## Verifying this change

This change added tests and can be verified as follows:

  - Two new tests in `FineGrainedSlotManagerTest`, one per path: the first delayed check or declaration throws, the second must still run. Both time out after 5 s on the unmodified tree and pass with the change.
  - `FineGrainedSlotManagerTest` 22 of 22 and `FineGrainedSlotManagerDefaultResourceAllocationStrategyITCase` 18 of 18, none skipped.
